data.name: Flockers™
data.detailed_description:
For over nineteen years sheep have been an integral part of the worms’ fearsome arsenal. Held for years within the evil thrall of their diabolical masters the sheep are finally making a dash for freedom! Escaping the tyrannical worms, the flock must dodge its way past all manner of lethal machinery and traps as the sheep negotiate their path through the confinement of the Worms’ weapons factory out into the testing grounds and ever onwards towards pastures green.

Flockers is a modern day take on the classic A to B puzzle genre with a generous helping of sinister foreboding and dark humour for good measure. Levels have been designed to challenge the player’s skill and strategic planning as they attempt to guide their flock past heinous traps, sadistic devices and diabolical puzzles; rewarding those that can save the most sheep while still allowing progression for anyone who falls foul of the factory’s deadly machinery.

Key Features:

  • 60 gruelling & puzzling levels to master.

  • 6 bonus levels - Psst... Hidden throughout the campaign levels are portals to a greener, more tranquil place. Discover them to unlock a new play mode where waking lazy sleeping sheep becomes the priority…

  • Rewards - Want a zombie sheep? You got it! Green blood? Yes sir.. There are a stack load of customisation rewards to unlock by fulfilling a wide range of objectives. Choose from 17 crazy skins and 6 types of blood.

  • Create your own levels - We’re including a powerful level creation tool, the "Meat Maker", that will give you the power to design your own deadly puzzles. (Currently only available on PC)

  • Steam Workshop integration - Share your own creations with the community and play challenging levels created by other Flockers players.

  • Steam Leaderboards - Players can compete against their friends and others in an attempt to get the fastest time on a level and the fastest time in the story mode.

  • Star system - Player performance is assessed via a star rating system encouraging players to perfect each level.

  • Twitch support - Share your sheep herding talents to a wider audience with integrated Twitch support.

  • Steam Achievements - Demonstrate your gaming prowess and show off to your friends by earning Flockers achievements.

reviews.review:
Flockers is a puzzle-strategy game developed and published by Team17 Digital Ltd., a studio famous for creating inventive and often humorous experiences. While the game draws inspiration from classic flock-management puzzle titles, it establishes its own identity through a darkly comedic setting, elaborate death traps, and a surprisingly deep collection of mechanics. Rather than leading cheerful creatures through colorful landscapes, players guide a group of sheep attempting to escape a brutal industrial regime where almost every machine, platform, and corridor seems designed to end their journey in spectacular fashion.

The gameplay revolves around escorting sheep safely through hazardous levels by assigning special abilities and carefully planning their routes. Each stage presents a self-contained puzzle packed with moving machinery, crushing devices, spinning blades, explosives, and environmental hazards. Success requires observation, experimentation, and an understanding of how different abilities interact with the environment. As new mechanics are introduced, the challenges become increasingly intricate, forcing players to think several steps ahead. The game manages to capture the spirit of classic puzzle-solving while modernizing the formula with physics-based interactions and more dynamic level construction.

One of Flockers' greatest strengths is its level design. The campaign gradually introduces new concepts, ensuring that players learn the rules naturally before being asked to solve more demanding challenges. Early levels encourage experimentation, while later stages require precision and strategic planning. The progression feels rewarding because each new obstacle adds another layer of complexity without overwhelming the player immediately. Hidden objectives, collectible items, and optional challenges further enhance replay value, giving completionists plenty of reasons to revisit earlier stages.

The visual presentation effectively supports the game's unusual tone. Industrial factories, grim workshops, and mechanical deathtraps dominate the environments, creating a world that feels both hostile and strangely entertaining. Despite the dark premise, the art style remains colorful and cartoon-like, preventing the atmosphere from becoming excessively grim. The exaggerated animations and humorous reactions of the sheep help maintain a playful tone even when disaster strikes. This contrast between adorable animals and absurdly dangerous machinery becomes one of the game's defining characteristics.

Customization and progression systems add extra motivation beyond simply completing levels. Players can unlock various cosmetic appearances for their sheep, ranging from quirky costumes to bizarre themed designs. These rewards do not alter gameplay, but they provide a fun sense of accomplishment and encourage exploration. Combined with achievements and collectibles, the unlockable content helps extend the game's longevity and gives dedicated players additional goals to pursue.

Another noteworthy aspect is the game's willingness to embrace failure as a learning tool. Many puzzles require repeated attempts before a successful solution becomes apparent. Fortunately, quick restarts and responsive controls minimize frustration, allowing experimentation to remain enjoyable. Watching plans fail often provides valuable information for future attempts, creating a satisfying cycle of learning and improvement. This design philosophy ensures that even difficult stages rarely feel unfair.

The audio design complements the experience well. Mechanical sounds, environmental effects, and fitting background music help reinforce the industrial atmosphere. The soundtrack remains subtle enough not to distract from puzzle-solving while still contributing to the overall mood. Combined with the visual style, the audio helps create a world that feels alive despite its relentless hostility toward the flock.

Flockers is not without flaws. Some late-game puzzles can become exceptionally challenging, occasionally relying on solutions that may not be immediately obvious. Certain players may also find the trial-and-error approach repetitive during extended sessions. Additionally, while the game introduces a respectable variety of mechanics, its core structure remains firmly rooted in the classic puzzle formula that inspired it. Those seeking a narrative-heavy experience or dramatic gameplay evolution may find the experience somewhat limited.

Even with these shortcomings, Flockers stands out as a clever and entertaining puzzle game that successfully modernizes a beloved genre. Its combination of challenging level design, dark humor, creative hazards, and rewarding progression creates an experience that remains engaging from beginning to end. Team17 delivers a distinctive adventure that balances strategy, experimentation, and comedy with impressive confidence. For players who enjoy thoughtful puzzles and don't mind sacrificing a few sheep along the way, Flockers offers a memorable journey filled with challenge, creativity, and plenty of laughs.

Rating: 7/10
